itineraries.title: Hillsborough Halloween Friday: Studio Tour Preview, Witch's Barn, Merchants' Trick-or-Treat, Haunting Hour, Last Fridays
itineraries.theme: A small-town Halloween Friday: an art-guild preview show, the no-actor Witch's Haunted Barn at Firefly Farm, downtown merchants' trick-or-treat, ghost stories at the Visitors Center, then the Last Fridays Art Walk
itineraries.drive_time: About 45 min from downtown Raleigh to downtown Hillsborough via I-40 W / I-85 S; Elmo's Diner (Durham) is on the way, about 20 min short of Hillsborough. Drive time from downtown Hillsborough to Firefly Farm (4911 Hunt Rd) was not checked; look it up before leaving
itineraries.cost_range: Preview show, trick-or-treat, Art Walk and gallery reception free; Witch's Barn $13 per person (2 and under free); Haunting Hour $10-$20; about $40-$55 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A warm, sunny Friday (high 82°F; sunset about 6:20 PM, before DST ends). Eat breakfast at Elmo's Diner in Durham on the drive west, see the Orange County Artists Guild studio-tour preview on Churton St, and have lunch at the Village Diner. Spend early afternoon at Firefly Farm's no-actor Witch's Haunted Barn and pumpkin patch, come back for the downtown merchants' trick-or-treat (3-5 PM), catch the 5 PM Haunting Hour storytelling at the Visitors Center, then walk Last Fridays & the Art Walk before a late dinner at Nomad.

morning.title: Orange County Artist Guild Studio Tour Preview Show
morning.location: Hillsborough Gallery of Arts, 121 N. Churton St., Hillsborough, NC 27278
morning.notes: Open 10 AM-9 PM. Preview exhibition of work by artists on the Orange County Artists Guild open studio tour; use it to plan studio visits. Info: http://www.HillsboroughGallery.com

afternoon.title: Witch's Haunted Barn (No-Actor Friday) at Firefly Farm
afternoon.location: Firefly Farm, 4911 Hunt Road, Hillsborough, NC 27278
afternoon.notes: Noon-5 PM. Farm site lists Oct 30 as a No-Actor Friday (less scary, same barn and pumpkin patch). $13 per person; ages 2 and under free. Tickets/info: https://www.fireflyfarmnc.com/hauntedbarn-pumpkinpatch. Leave by about 2:30 PM to be downtown for trick-or-treat.

afternoon.title: Downtown Hillsborough Merchants' Trick-or-Treat
afternoon.location: Downtown Hillsborough, Churton & King St, Hillsborough, NC 27278
afternoon.notes: 3-5 PM. Downtown small businesses hand out candy. Info: https://visithillsboroughnc.com/event/downtown-hillsborough-merchants-trick-or-treat/

evening.title: The Haunting Hour
evening.location: Hillsborough Visitor Center, 150 E King St, Hillsborough, NC 27278
evening.notes: Storytelling performances at 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM (per The Triangle Weekender listing); the optional 'Tales from the Grave' graveyard mini-tour runs 5-8:30 PM. Tickets: https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/the-haunting-hour--2026 (the ticket page blocked automated checks; open it in a browser).

evening.title: Last Fridays & The Art Walk
evening.location: Old Orange County Courthouse, 104 East King St, Hillsborough, NC 27278
evening.notes: 5:30-9 PM. Monthly Art Walk with 19 participating venues (receptions, demos). Info: https://www.hillsboroughartscouncil.org/last-fridays

evening.title: Backroads and Byways, Landscapes Opening Reception
evening.location: Margaret Lane Gallery, 121 W Margaret Lane, Hillsborough, NC 27278
evening.notes: 6-9 PM, part of the Art Walk: Jeff McEntire landscapes. Info: https://thetriangleweekender.com/event/backroads-and-byways-landscapes-opening-reception/

food.vegetarian_dish: Breakfast "Soyrrito" (scrambled eggs, soy sausage, sautéed onions, red sauce, melted cheese, served with frijoles and a side)
food.notes: 776 9th Street, Durham NC 27705, on the way from Raleigh. Own site: Mon-Fri 7 AM-3 PM. Own menu: Breakfast 'Soyrrito' $9.50 (scrambled eggs, soy sausage, onions, red sauce, melted cheese; vegetarian by its listed ingredients, not labeled). No vegan dish verified.

food.vegetarian_dish: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup Cup (American cheese, tomato, onion, pesto mayo on potato bread, with tomato soup)
food.notes: 600 W. King St., Hillsborough NC 27278. Menu PDF (dated 10-2025, linked from its own site) lists hours Tue-Sat 8 AM-1:30 PM; arrive by about 12:15. Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup Cup $13 (American cheese, tomato, onion, pesto mayo on potato bread) and Tomato Soup Bowl $9. Vegetarian by listed ingredients, not labeled. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegan_dish: Chana Masala (GF/VG): chickpeas, potato curry, pickled onions, basmati rice
food.vegetarian_dish: Thai Cauliflower (GF/VG): roasted and flash-fried cauliflower, red Thai sauce, roasted coconut, peanuts
food.notes: 122 West King Street, Hillsborough NC 27278 (in the historic Osbunn Theater), one block from the Art Walk. Own site: Wed-Fri 5-10 PM. Own menu: Chana Masala $19 (GF/VG), Thai Cauliflower $13 (GF/VG).

alternatives.leg: Firefly Farm Witch's Barn and pumpkin patch (outdoor and barn)
alternatives.good_weather: Sunny and about 80°F in the afternoon. Bring water and sun protection for the pumpkin patch.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If plans change, stay downtown: the Studio Tour Preview Show at Hillsborough Gallery of Arts is open until 9 PM (event 2bebf4b33592, free).

alternatives.leg: Merchants' Trick-or-Treat and Last Fridays Art Walk (outdoor, downtown)
alternatives.good_weather: Warm and clear into the evening; sunset about 6:20 PM. Walk the courthouse lawn before dark.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If needed, stay indoors: The Haunting Hour runs hourly until 9 PM at the Visitor Center (event f6c28c67a1b7), and the Margaret Lane Gallery reception is indoors (event 2a6ef6b812c9).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 7:30 AM for breakfast at Elmo's (776 9th St, Durham), then continue on I-85 S to Hillsborough by about 10 AM.

Downtown Hillsborough is walkable: the gallery (121 N Churton), Visitor Center (150 E King), courthouse lawn (104 E King) and Nomad (122 W King) are within a few blocks. Park once downtown for the evening.
Firefly Farm: $13 per person, ages 2 and under free. Info: https://www.fireflyfarmnc.com/hauntedbarn-pumpkinpatch
Haunting Hour tickets: https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/the-haunting-hour--2026
Last Fridays details: https://www.hillsboroughartscouncil.org/last-fridays
Drive back to Raleigh takes about 45 min.

itineraries.title: Wake Forest Friday: Hill Ridge Farms Pumpkin Festival, Barks & Boos, Spirits of Wake Forest Ghost Walk
itineraries.theme: A northern-Wake Friday: the last week of the Hill Ridge Farms fall festival, a Halloween open house at the Saving Grace dog rescue, and a 75-minute ghost walk through historic downtown Wake Forest
itineraries.drive_time: About 30 min from downtown Raleigh to downtown Wake Forest via US-1 N / Capital Blvd; Hill Ridge Farms (Youngsville) is about 15 min further north. Drive times between stops were not checked
itineraries.cost_range: Hill Ridge Farms $24.95 per person ages 2-64 ($22.95 65+/military, under 2 free); Barks & Boos free; ghost walk $20 per person; about $40-$55 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A warm, sunny Friday (high 82°F; sunset about 6:20 PM). Breakfast at Brigs in Wake Forest, then spend the morning at Hill Ridge Farms in Youngsville (train, carousel and wagon rides, barnyard, free pumpkin with admission). Lunch at Village Deli & Grill on S Main St, take an easy afternoon, then visit the Saving Grace Barks & Boos open house (5-7 PM) before the 6:30 PM Spirits of Wake Forest ghost walk downtown. Finish with dinner at Curry House.

morning.title: Hill Ridge Farms Fall Pumpkin Festival
morning.location: Hill Ridge Farms, 703 Tarboro Road, Youngsville, NC 27596
morning.notes: Open 9:30 AM-6:30 PM on Fri Oct 30 (farm site). Admission includes unlimited train, wagon and carousel rides, playland, and a free pumpkin. Tickets at the gate only (no online sales); cash, card and tap accepted. Prices are from the farm's admission page (the event record lists price as unknown). Info: https://www.hillridgefarms.com/

afternoon.title: Lunch, then free time in downtown Wake Forest
afternoon.location: S White St, downtown Wake Forest, NC 27587
afternoon.notes: After lunch on S Main St, walk the downtown business district along S White St; the evening ghost walk covers the same blocks.

evening.title: Barks and Boos Open House & Supply Drive
evening.location: Saving Grace, 13400 Old Creedmoor Rd, Wake Forest, NC 27587
evening.notes: 5-7 PM. Meet adoptable dogs and tour the farm's Halloween decor; supply donations welcome. Stay about 45 min, then drive to Town Hall for the 6:30 PM walk. Info: https://www.visitraleigh.com/event/barks-and-boos-open-house-%26-supply-drive/111465/

evening.title: Spirits of Wake Forest Ghost Walk
evening.location: Wake Forest Town Hall (meeting point), 301 South Brooks Street, Wake Forest, NC
evening.notes: Town page: Friday tours at 6:30 PM and 8 PM; about 1 hour 15 minutes; max 20 per tour; rain or shine; not recommended under 8; ticket required for every attendee. Tickets: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2026-spirits-of-wake-forest-tickets-1994208274632

food.vegetarian_dish: Classic Avocado Toast (whole-grain toast, mashed avocado, lemon-olive oil, fresh cilantro, two eggs any style)
food.notes: 12338 Wake Union Church Road, Wake Forest NC 27587; open 7 AM-2:30 PM daily (own site). Own menu: Classic avocado toast (whole-grain toast with mashed avocado, lemon-olive oil and cilantro, served with two eggs) and the Malibu omelet (spinach, avocado, mushrooms, tomatoes, cheddar-jack). Both vegetarian by listed ingredients, not labeled. The online menu shows no prices. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegetarian_dish: Tempeh Reuben (marinated organic tempeh, sauerkraut, melted Swiss, 1000 Island, grilled rye)
food.notes: 1849 S. Main St, #200, Wake Forest NC 27587; Mon-Fri 11 AM-9 PM (own location page). Own menu, Vegetarian section: Tempeh Reuben $13.50 and Anna's Veggie Pita $13.50 (hummus, spring mix, vegetables, feta). No vegan dish verified.

food.vegetarian_dish: Palak Paneer (chopped spinach with ginger, garlic, mild spices and homemade cheese)
food.notes: 2101 S Main St #116, Wake Forest NC 27587. Its Toast ordering menu lists Palak Paneer $16.95 and Chana Masala $14.95 (chickpeas, ginger, garlic, tomatoes, onions; no dairy listed but not labeled vegan; ask). Friday hours (11:30 AM-9:45 PM) come from third-party listings, not the restaurant; call (919) 263-1222 to confirm.

alternatives.good_weather: Sunny, warming toward 80°F by noon. Do the wagon ride and barnyard first.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. The farm posts weather updates on its social media pages.

alternatives.good_weather: Clear and mild after sunset (about 6:20 PM). If 6:30 PM sells out, the 8 PM Friday tour is the other slot.
alternatives.rain: Tours run rain or shine. Indoor alternative: An Evening with Murray Attaway, Don Dixon & Peter Holsapple at Wake Forest Listening Room, 219 S. White St (doors 6:45 PM, show 7:30 PM, $33.90, event 729f0629726b).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 7:45 AM for breakfast at Brigs, then head north to Hill Ridge Farms for the 9:30 AM opening.
Hill Ridge Farms sells admission at the gate only; last admission is one hour before closing. Admission page: https://www.hillridgefarms.com/admission-tickets
Ghost walk tickets (Eventbrite): https://www.eventbrite.com/e/2026-spirits-of-wake-forest-tickets-1994208274632. Meet outside Wake Forest Town Hall, 301 S Brooks St; tours start on time.
Saving Grace is on Old Creedmoor Rd on the west side of Wake Forest; allow drive time to Town Hall before 6:30 PM (not checked).
Drive back to Raleigh from S Main St takes about 25-30 min.

itineraries.title: Raleigh Halloween Saturday: Day of the Dead Street Festival, Halloween at Hogwarts, Pumpkin Palooza, Rosencrantz and Guildenstern
itineraries.theme: A downtown-to-Pullen Park Halloween: a Día de los Muertos street festival, the NC Symphony's costumed Harry Potter family concert, Pumpkin Palooza at Pullen Park, and Stoppard at Raleigh Little Theatre
itineraries.drive_time: 0-10 min: the festival, concert and lunch are a walk apart downtown; Pullen Park and Raleigh Little Theatre are about 10 min west by car
itineraries.cost_range: Street festival free; Halloween at Hogwarts $32-$46; Pumpkin Palooza $14; Rosencrantz and Guildenstern $30-$33; about $45-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A mild Halloween (high 68°F, partly sunny; overnight 48°F and mostly cloudy; sunset about 6:20 PM). Breakfast at Morning Times, then the free Day of the Dead street festival on Wilmington St. Walk to the Martin Marietta Center for the 11 AM Halloween at Hogwarts concert (costumes welcome), lunch at Sitti, and spend mid-afternoon at Pumpkin Palooza in Pullen Park. Dinner at Irregardless, then Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead at Raleigh Little Theatre.

morning.title: Day of the Dead 5k & Street Festival
morning.location: Centro Mexican Restaurant, 106 S Wilmington St, Raleigh, NC 27601
morning.notes: 9 AM-12 PM. Free street festival on Wilmington St between Hargett and Morgan Sts: artisans, vendors, food from Centro and food trucks, live music, cultural performances and Día de los Muertos altars. The 5K is a separate paid registration. Info: https://downtownraleigh.org/do/day-of-the-dead-5k-and-street-festival-1

morning.title: Family Fun Concert! Halloween at Hogwarts with the North Carolina Symphony
morning.location: Meymandi Concert Hall at Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts, 2 E South St., Raleigh, NC 27601
morning.notes: 11 AM-12 PM. Harry Potter music; costumes encouraged. NC Symphony page: lobby doors open 9:30 AM, pre-concert activities start an hour before the show, costume contest, Meredith Suzuki Strings at 10:15 AM. Leave the festival by about 10:30. Tickets: https://ncsymphony.org/events/halloween-at-hogwarts-11am/

afternoon.title: Pumpkin Palooza at Pullen Park
afternoon.location: Pullen Park, 520 Ashe Avenue, Raleigh, NC 27606
afternoon.notes: 10:30 AM-4 PM. Each ticket includes a digital scavenger hunt, a train ride, a small pumpkin, and autumn crafts and games. Pick a time slot and buy in advance. Tickets: https://raleighnc.gov/parks-and-recreation/events/pumpkin-palooza-pullen-park (city site blocked automated checks; listing confirmed at https://thetriangleweekender.com/event/pumpkin-palooza-at-pullen-park/2026-10-31/).

evening.title: Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead
evening.location: Raleigh Little Theatre - Gaddy-Goodwin Teaching Theatre, 301 Pogue Street, Raleigh, NC 27607
evening.notes: 7:30 PM. RLT page: about 2 hours 30 minutes with one intermission; ages 13+; adult $33, senior/student/military $30. Tickets: https://raleighlittletheatre.org/shows/rosencrantz-and-guildenstern-are-dead/

food.vegetarian_dish: Avocado Toast (multigrain toast, diced potatoes, house guacamole, tomato, cotija)
food.notes: 10 E. Hargett Street, Raleigh NC 27601, about two blocks from the festival. Own menu: all items served daily 7 AM-5 PM. Avocado Toast $7.50 (Bread Shop multigrain, diced potatoes, house guacamole, tomato, cotija); Breakfast Burrito $11.25 (eggs, cotija, black beans, roasted jalapeño, salsa). Vegetarian by listed ingredients, not labeled. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegan_dish: Vegan Tasting: hummus, mouhamra, fattoush, warak anab, roasted vegetables, falafel
food.vegetarian_dish: Vegetarian Tasting: hummus, baba ghanouj, fattoush, cheese rolls, warak anab, falafel
food.notes: 135 S. Wilmington Street, Raleigh NC 27601, a short walk from the Martin Marietta Center. Own site: Fri-Sat 11 AM-10 PM. Own lunch menu: Vegan Tasting $19.95 (labeled vegan) and Vegetarian Tasting $19.95 (labeled vegetarian).

food.vegan_dish: Mujaddara (VG): beluga lentils, walnut muhamarra, jasmine rice, golden raisin chutney, pickled red onion, cabbage slaw, grilled pita
food.vegetarian_dish: Eggplant Tower (VEG, GF): breaded and fried eggplant, mozzarella, marinara, basil oil
food.notes: 901 W Morgan St, Raleigh NC 27603, about 5 min from Raleigh Little Theatre. Own site: dinner Fri-Sat 4:30-10 PM. Own dinner menu: Mujaddara $19 (VG, GFO), Eggplant Tower $17 (VEG, GF). Eat by 5:30 PM to make the 7:30 curtain.

alternatives.leg: Day of the Dead street festival (outdoor)
alternatives.good_weather: Partly sunny and cool in the morning; bring a layer.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If needed, go straight to the Martin Marietta Center: the Hogwarts lobby opens at 9:30 AM with pre-concert activities.

alternatives.good_weather: High 68°F. Do the train ride and scavenger hunt before the 4 PM close.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. Indoor swap: Hocus Pocus at The Rialto Theatre, 1620 Glenwood Ave (doors 1:30 PM, show 2 PM, $11, event f601cd1723a6).

practical_notes: Park once downtown for the morning (decks near Moore Square or the Martin Marietta Center); the festival, concert and Sitti are walkable. Wilmington St between Hargett and Morgan is closed for the festival.
Hogwarts tickets: https://ncsymphony.org/events/halloween-at-hogwarts-11am/ (a 2 PM performance also exists if 11 AM sells out).
Pumpkin Palooza uses timed tickets; book a slot around 1:45 PM.
Irregardless and Raleigh Little Theatre are both west of downtown; RLT has its own lot off Pogue St.
Halloween night: expect crowds and bar-crawl traffic around Glenwood South after 4 PM.

itineraries.title: Chapel Hill & Carrboro Halloween: Farmers' Market Costumes, Goatober Fest, LGBT+ History Walk, Scare-olina Skies, Improvised Horror Movie
itineraries.theme: Halloween across Chapel Hill and Carrboro: the market's vendor costume contest, goats and pumpkins at Spring Haven Farm, a walking tour of Chapel Hill's LGBT+ history, a Halloween planetarium show, and a live improvised horror movie
itineraries.drive_time: About 35-40 min from downtown Raleigh to downtown Chapel Hill via I-40 W; Carrboro is about 5 min further west. Drive time to Spring Haven Farm (5306 Homer Ruffin Rd) was not checked
itineraries.cost_range: Farmers' market free; Goatober Fest $13.95-$19.95 (pumpkin carving extra); walking tour $14; Scare-olina Skies price unknown; Improvised Horror Movie $25; about $50-$70 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A mild Halloween (high 68°F, partly sunny; 48°F overnight; sunset about 6:20 PM). Breakfast at Carolina Coffee Shop, then the Carrboro Farmers' Market Halloween costume contest. Late morning at Goatober Fest at Spring Haven Farm, brunch-lunch at Kipos, the 2 PM LGBT+ history walking tour, and the 4:30 PM Scare-olina Skies planetarium show. Dinner at Glasshalfull in Carrboro, then The Improvised Horror Movie at The ArtsCenter. UNC hosts Miami at Kenan Stadium at 7:30 PM, so downtown Chapel Hill will be crowded from mid-afternoon.

morning.title: Halloween at the Carrboro Farmers' Market
morning.location: Carrboro Farmers' Market, 301 W. Main Street, Carrboro, NC 27510
morning.notes: 7 AM-noon. Last Saturday of main-season hours, with the annual vendor Halloween costume contest. Info: https://thetriangleweekender.com/event/%f0%9f%8e%83-halloween-at-the-carrboro-farmers-market/

morning.title: Goatober Fest | Carving Pumpkins with Goats
morning.location: Spring Haven Farm, 5306 Homer Ruffin Road, Chapel Hill, NC 27516
morning.notes: Starts 10 AM. Farm animals, bubble barn, farm games. Ticket page: arrive within the arrival time on your ticket; weekend slots can sell out, so buy ahead. Pumpkin carving with the goats is separate (small $9, medium $12, large $15) and needs a Goatober ticket; VIP parking $10. Tickets: https://www.simpletix.com/e/goatober-fest-carving-pumpkins-with-goats-tickets-288348

afternoon.title: Chapel Hill LGBT+ History | Walking Tour
afternoon.location: Rougarou Cajun Kitchen (Imbibe), 108 Henderson Street, Chapel Hill, NC 27514
afternoon.notes: 2-3 PM. Walking tour of Chapel Hill's LGBT+ history. Book: https://www.trianglewalkingtours.com/booking-calendar/chapel-hill-lgbt-history-tour?category=0fd7a45f-c9e7-4fde-8b77-b953462112a9&referral=service_list_widget

afternoon.title: Scare-olina Skies — A Thrilling Planetarium Experience
afternoon.location: Morehead Planetarium & Science Center, 250 East Franklin Street, Chapel Hill, NC 27514
afternoon.notes: 4:30-5:30 PM. Halloween tour of Chapel Hill's spooky side under the dome. Price not shown on the listing; check the ticket link https://go.unc.edu/Scare-olina or https://moreheadplanetarium.org/calendar/scare-olina-skies-6/

evening.title: The Improvised Horror Movie | Rated R
evening.notes: 8:30 PM (confirmed on Black Sheep Comedy's show list). A horror movie improvised live from audience suggestions; rated R. Tickets: https://www.blacksheepcomedy.com/shows

food.vegetarian_dish: Avocado Toast (sliced avocado on toasted bread of your choice, arugula salad, fresh lemon)
food.notes: 138 East Franklin Street, Chapel Hill NC 27514; brunch every day 8 AM-3 PM (own site). Fall 2026 brunch menu PDF: Avocado Toast $13 (sliced avocado on toast, arugula salad, fresh lemon; no animal products listed but not labeled vegan; ask about the bread) and Feta, Tomato, Spinach and Onion omelet $12. Weekends are busy and reservations are Mon-Thu only.

food.vegan_dish: Briam (Vegan; GF): roasted zucchini, tomatoes, eggplant, potatoes, carrots
food.vegetarian_dish: Greek Omelet (Vegetarian; GF): feta, tomato, spinach, scallion, mixed green salad, roasted potatoes
food.notes: 1800 E. Franklin St. #16, Chapel Hill NC 27514 (own site; note this is east of downtown). Own site: brunch Sat-Sun 11 AM-2:30 PM. Own brunch menu: Briam $16 (Vegan; Gluten Free), Greek Omelet $16 (Vegetarian; Gluten Free). Leave by 1:40 PM for the 2 PM tour on Henderson St.

food.vegan_dish: Fried Brussels Sprouts (V+ GF): agave-lemon glaze, red pepper flakes, toasted peanuts
food.vegetarian_dish: Beet and Kale Lasagna (V): house beet pasta, kale, leeks, pine nuts, ricotta, goat cheese, beet purée
food.notes: 106 South Greensboro Street, Carrboro NC 27510, a few blocks from The ArtsCenter. Own site: dinner Fri-Sat 5-9:30 PM. Own dinner menu (V = vegetarian, V+ = vegan): Fried Brussels Sprouts $12 (V+ GF), Turkish Hummus $13 (V+, GF without lavash), Beet and Kale Lasagna $26 (V).

alternatives.good_weather: Partly sunny and cool in the morning; dress for the farm.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. Indoor swap: Magic Tree House Space Mission at Morehead Planetarium (10:30 AM, price unknown, event ffb3e95cba51).

No rain is forecast. Indoor swap: 'A Closer Look at the Collection' free 30-min tour at the Ackland Art Museum, 101 S Columbia St (1 PM, event f2daaf308287), or We Are Stars at Morehead Planetarium (1:30 PM, price unknown, event d28e9832c66f).

practical_notes: Leave downtown Raleigh by 7:20 AM for breakfast on Franklin St.

UNC vs Miami kicks off at 7:30 PM at Kenan Stadium: expect closed streets, game-day parking rates and heavy traffic around campus and Franklin St from mid-afternoon. Morehead Planetarium and the walking tour start point are near campus; consider parking in Carrboro and walking or riding transit in.
Goatober tickets are timed by arrival window: https://www.simpletix.com/e/goatober-fest-carving-pumpkins-with-goats-tickets-288348
Walking tour booking: https://www.trianglewalkingtours.com/booking-calendar/chapel-hill-lgbt-history-tour?category=0fd7a45f-c9e7-4fde-8b77-b953462112a9&referral=service_list_widget
Improvised Horror Movie tickets: https://www.blacksheepcomedy.com/shows. Glasshalfull and The ArtsCenter are both in downtown Carrboro; park once.
Drive back to Raleigh from Carrboro takes about 40 min.

itineraries.title: Downtown Cary Sunday: Historic Walking Tour, Cary Underground Market, Symphonic Soundscapes
itineraries.theme: An easy, walkable downtown Cary Sunday on the day clocks fall back: a guided history walk, a maker market with live bands at Bond Brothers, and a Triangle Wind Ensemble concert
itineraries.drive_time: About 20 min from downtown Raleigh to downtown Cary via I-40 W / Walnut St; every stop is within about a mile in downtown Cary
itineraries.cost_range: Walking tour $15; Underground Market free; Symphonic Soundscapes free-$20; about $40-$55 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: Daylight saving time ends at 2 AM, so everything runs on standard time and sunset moves to about 5:20 PM. A mostly cloudy, mild day (high 71°F). Breakfast at La Farm Bakery's downtown café, take the noon Downtown Cary historic walking tour, then brunch-lunch at Peck & Plume next door. Browse the Cary Underground Market (30+ vendors, live bands, food trucks) at Bond Brothers, hear the Triangle Wind Ensemble at 4 PM at the Cary Arts Center, and finish with South Indian vegetarian food at Udupi Cafe.

morning.title: Breakfast and a stroll in downtown Cary
morning.location: Downtown Cary, S Academy St / W Chatham St, Cary, NC 27511
morning.notes: No ticketed event this morning: eat at La Farm (220 W Chatham St) and walk the downtown blocks before the noon tour.

afternoon.title: Cary Downtown Historic Guided Walking Tour
afternoon.notes: 12-1 PM. Guided walk through Cary's history as a railroad hub, with stories of agricultural invention and early integration. Book: https://www.trianglewalkingtours.com/book-online?category=207ada13-29de-4868-acc1-e68111265890

afternoon.title: Cary Underground Market
afternoon.location: Bond Brothers Beer Company, 202 East Cedar Street, Cary, NC 27511
afternoon.notes: 12-4 PM. Monthly market and concert series with 30+ local vendors, live bands and food trucks; free to attend. Info: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/cary-underground-market-tickets-1999287158711

afternoon.title: Symphonic Soundscapes
afternoon.location: Cary Arts Center, 101 Dry Ave., Cary, NC 27511
afternoon.notes: 4-5:30 PM. Triangle Wind Ensemble: Tchaikovsky's Capriccio Italien, Elgar's Nimrod and more. Info: https://www.visitraleigh.com/event/symphonic-soundscapes/111726/ ; Town of Cary page: https://www.carync.gov/Home/Components/Calendar/Event/27074/1636?curm=11&cury=2026 (town site blocked automated checks).

evening.title: Dinner at Udupi Cafe
evening.location: Udupi Cafe, 590 E Chatham St, Ste 112 & 114, Cary, NC 27511
evening.notes: Sunday hours 11:30 AM-9 PM on its own ordering site. See Food for the dish.

food.vegetarian_dish: Spinach Feta Quiche (sautéed spinach, feta, onion, eggs, cream, flaky crust; with brunch potatoes, mini scone, fruit)
food.notes: 220 W. Chatham St., Cary NC (own site). Own café brunch menu, served 8 AM-3 PM Sundays: Spinach Feta Quiche (spinach, feta, onion, eggs, cream, with brunch potatoes, mini scone and fruit) and Eggs Florentine. Vegetarian by listed ingredients, not labeled. The online menu shows no prices. No vegan dish verified.

food.vegetarian_dish: Avocado Toast (NF, V): sourdough, beet root hummus, avocado, boondi, pomegranate, whipped ricotta, za'atar
food.notes: 301 S Academy St, Cary NC 27511, steps from the walking tour start. Own site: brunch Sat-Sun 8 AM-2 PM, so order by about 1:45 PM. Own brunch menu (V = vegetarian, VG = vegan): Avocado Toast (NF, V) $14, Chilaquiles Verdes (NF, GF, V) $15. No brunch item is labeled VG, so no vegan dish was verified.

food.vegetarian_dish: Mysore Masala Dosai (Vegetarian): thin rice crepe with spicy chutney, potato and onion stuffing
food.notes: 590 E Chatham St, Ste 112 & 114, Cary NC. Own site: Sunday 11:30 AM-9 PM; South Indian vegetarian cuisine. Own menu: Masala Dosai $12.99 (Vegetarian), Mysore Masala Dosai $13.99 (Vegetarian). No item is labeled vegan; the site calls the cuisine vegan-friendly, so ask about ghee and dairy.

alternatives.good_weather: Mostly cloudy and about 70°F at noon.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. Indoor swap: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom at The Cary Theater, 122 E. Chatham St. (12 PM, price unknown, event e1d235a2e087).

alternatives.leg: Cary Underground Market (indoor/patio at the brewery)
alternatives.good_weather: For an outdoor afternoon instead, go to Fall Farewell at Phillips Farms of Cary (1-6 PM, $22, event e064f78f2317); it is about 20 min from downtown, so skip the 4 PM concert if you do.
alternatives.rain: The market is at the brewery; the concert is indoors at the Cary Arts Center.

practical_notes: Clocks fall back one hour at 2 AM on Nov 1. All times here are standard time (EST).

Leave downtown Raleigh by 9:30 AM. Park once in downtown Cary: La Farm (220 W Chatham), the tour start (114 S Academy), Peck & Plume (301 S Academy), Bond Brothers (202 E Cedar) and the Cary Arts Center (101 Dry Ave) are all within about a mile.
Walking tour booking: https://www.trianglewalkingtours.com/book-online?category=207ada13-29de-4868-acc1-e68111265890
Udupi Cafe is on E Chatham St east of downtown; drive the last leg.
Drive back to Raleigh takes about 20-25 min.

itineraries.title: Durham Election Day Tuesday: Candy Carver Installation, Kids Voting Celebration, Astronomy on Tap
itineraries.theme: A free weekday in downtown Durham on Election Day: a black-light art installation at the Durham Fringe Festival lounge, the Kids Voting celebration at Durham Central Park, and Astronomy on Tap science talks at Fullsteam
itineraries.drive_time: About 30 min from downtown Raleigh to downtown Durham via I-40 W / NC-147 (Durham Freeway); all stops are in or near downtown Durham
itineraries.cost_range: All three events free; about $45-$60 per person for meals
itineraries.overview: A warm, partly sunny Election Day (high 75°F; standard time, sunset about 5:20 PM). Vote first if you are registered, then breakfast at Monuts on Ninth Street. Spend late morning at the Candy Carver black-light installation in the Fringe Festival lounge, lunch at Toast, and stop by the Kids Voting Election Day celebration at Durham Central Park. Dinner at Luna, then Astronomy on Tap talks and trivia at Fullsteam's American Tobacco Campus taproom.

morning.title: Candy Carver, Find Your Glimmer
morning.location: Durham Fringe Festival Lounge, 113 Orange St, Durham, NC 27701
morning.notes: 10 AM-10 PM. Immersive black-light art installation with affirmational text and interactive design. Info: https://durhamfringefestival.org/daily-schedule/ (site served a bot challenge to automated checks; open it in a browser to confirm the day's hours).

afternoon.title: Kids Voting Event
afternoon.location: Durham Central Park - The Pavilion, 501 Foster Street, Durham, NC 27701
afternoon.notes: 11 AM-4 PM. Kids Voting Durham Election Day Celebration with Durham 4-H and Juntos Durham. Info: https://durhamcentralpark.org/upcoming-event/kids-voting-event/ (site served a bot challenge to automated checks).

evening.title: Astronomy on Tap at Fullsteam
evening.location: Fullsteam Brewery (Fullsteam @ ATC), 320 Blackwell St, Suite 100, Durham, NC 27701
evening.notes: 7-9:30 PM. Short talks by working astronomers plus trivia; always free (Fullsteam asks attendees to buy a drink or food). Info: https://www.fullsteam.ag/event/astronomy-on-tap-11/2026-11-03

food.vegetarian_dish: Fall Hash (crispy smashed fingerling potatoes, marinated kale, lemon-garlic yogurt, two farm eggs, zhug, crispy za'atar chickpeas)
food.notes: 1002 Ninth Street, Durham NC 27705. Own site: full menu Tue-Fri 7 AM-3 PM. Fall 2026 menu PDF: Fall Hash $14 (smashed fingerling potatoes, marinated kale, lemon-garlic yogurt, two farm eggs, zhug, za'atar chickpeas); vegetarian by listed ingredients, not labeled. Vegan route: build-your-own bagel ($3) with Tofutti ($2) and avocado ($2) from the same menu; no item is labeled vegan.

food.vegan_dish: Portobello, Arugula, Roasted Tomato panino, made vegan on request (menu: 'vegetarian, can be vegan')
food.vegetarian_dish: Portobello, Fontina, Arugula, Roasted Tomato panino (vegetarian)
food.notes: 345 W. Main St., Durham NC 27701. Own site: Mon-Fri 11 AM-2:45 PM. Own menu: Portobello, Fontina, Arugula, Roasted Tomato panino $11 and Tuscan Kale, Ricotta Salata, Sweet & Hot Pickled Peppers panino $11, both '(vegetarian, can be vegan)'.

food.vegetarian_dish: Chili-lime Glazed Cauliflower (V): breaded and fried cauliflower, chili-lime glaze
food.notes: 112 W Main St, Durham NC 27701, about 10 min on foot from Fullsteam ATC. Own site: open seven days 11 AM-9 PM. Own menu (V = vegetarian, V+ = vegan): Chili Braised Jack Fruit (GF, V+) $16; Chili-lime Glazed Cauliflower (V) $11.

alternatives.leg: Kids Voting celebration at Durham Central Park (outdoor pavilion)
alternatives.good_weather: Partly sunny and about 75°F in the afternoon.
alternatives.rain: No rain is forecast. If plans change, spend more time at the indoor Candy Carver installation (open until 10 PM, event 3ba958520799).

alternatives.good_weather: Astronomy on Tap is indoors at Fullsteam ATC either way.
alternatives.rain: For live music instead: Maggie Koerner with Lydia Saint George at Stanczyks, 1007 W Main St (doors 7 PM, show 8 PM, all ages, $20-$25 in the event record; the ticket page showed $25.50; event 027e0e748fbe).

practical_notes: Nov 3 is Election Day; polls in North Carolina are open 6:30 AM-7:30 PM. Vote before leaving if you are registered.
Leave downtown Raleigh by 8 AM for breakfast on Ninth Street, then drive into downtown Durham (about 5 min) and park in a downtown deck for the rest of the day.
Downtown stops are walkable: Fringe lounge (113 Orange St), Toast (345 W Main), Durham Central Park (501 Foster St), Luna (112 W Main) and Fullsteam ATC (320 Blackwell St).
Astronomy on Tap details: https://www.fullsteam.ag/event/astronomy-on-tap-11/2026-11-03
Drive back to Raleigh takes about 30 min.
